none: PAS LIN-EDD96A: Roman nummus of Constantine I
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire, England (Inghilterra e Galles)

An incomplete and worn Roman copper-alloy nummus of Constantine I (AD 306–337), dating to AD 326–328 (Reece period 16). Reverse type: PROVIDENTIAE AVGG, depicting a campgate with two turrets and a star above. Mint: Possibly Lugdunum (Lyon), RIC 225. Obverse: Laureate bust facing right. * Inscription: CONSTA[N-TINVS AVG]. Reverse: Campgate with two turrets and a star above. * Inscription:…
